One of those shots proved to be fatal.
Mr. Christensen approached Mr. Cromarty from behind and shot him twice with a handgun

rationale_highlights: I also accept that Mr. Christensen's difficult family history and upbringing is an important mitigating factor to be considered

Crown counsel acknowledges that Mr. Christensen's life displays many traits that have moved the courts to consider the Gladue factors as reducing the moral blameworthiness of the offender. I accept that submission.
Mr. Christensen's family history echoes many of the themes that appear in the Gladue cases, including the effects of intergenerational trauma

This resulted in Gullickson being shot by a single gunshot wound [on] his left pectoral muscle
Diablo raised the revolver up towards Gullickson.
Diablo then used the revolver and shot through the front door of the Gullickson residence.
One bullet still remains inside of Gullickson
rationale_highlights: I have no doubt that Mr. Diablo experiences the continuing and ongoing trauma on a personal, family, community and Indigenous-nation level
Mr. Diablo's childhood was marred by violence and racism, and I have no doubt that his life continues to be impacted severely by these factors
Mitigating factors include that Mr. Diablo has a family history heavily influenced by the s. 718.2 factors, and historical impacts of colonialism
These factors appear to have a direct link on the functioning of Mr. Diablo
